text: Bonus fix (found because I actually drove the app): 14 `internal external fun` JNI declarations in KernelBridge.kt crashed with UnsatisfiedLinkError on the very first native call — sign-in, publish, ref resolution, all of it. Kotlin mangles `internal` JVM method names with a module-name suffix (`$app_debug`); the Rust cdylib's exported Java_... symbols don't carry that suffix. Made them plain `external fun` (public) — single Gradle module, `internal` bought nothing here. This was blocking literally any live validation of any Android build, unrelated to my two issues, so I fixed it rather than working around it.
